# Me, a 61-year-old, using the page to compare my S&P 500 fund

## 1. What I would do, and how sure I am

**I would not buy my iShares Swap fund yet.** If I had to act today, I would put the money in the fund the page picked for me, **"ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" in a Pesagot account ("פסגות")**. The page says I would end up with **86,492 ₪**.

How sure I am:
- **Sure (about 80%)** that I should not rush into my own fund. The page could not give me a straight answer about it.
- **Only about 50% sure** that Pesagot with Yelin Lapidot is the right choice. The top choices are only tens of shekels apart, so it hardly matters which one I take.

Here is why I'm holding back on my fund:
- In the list, my fund says **"עוד לא נאסף"** (not collected yet) and **"אין מחיר כאן"** (no price here).
- Further down, under **"עכשיו"**, it appears as **"קרן שנקנית בחו״ל"** (a fund bought abroad) with **59,196 ₪** and a red bar saying **"פחות 19,980 ₪"** (19,980 less).
- That is nearly 20,000 shekels less than the others. So what does this mean for my money? Either my fund is a very bad deal, or the number is unreliable. The page gives me both messages at once.
- The fee I typed in, **0.05%**, is higher than the Israeli fund's **"0.02%"**. So on that one number my fund isn't cheaper either.

## 2. The parts I actually used

- **Top inputs** ("סכום היום", "הפקדה חודשית", "שנים", "תשואה בשנה"), to check my amounts: 10,000 now, 500 a month, 10 years, 7% a year.
- **The three summary boxes**: "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪", "הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,492 ₪" and "הזוג הבא בתור 86,449 ₪".
- **The fund list on the left** ("כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500"), mainly to find my own fund's row.
- **The note under the list**, "למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות", and especially the line "בתעריפון אין שורה לניירות ערך זרים" (the price list has no line for foreign securities).
- **The "עכשיו" table** near the bottom, where my fund finally shows a number.
- **The footer notes**, especially "קרנות בחו״ל שהתעריפון שלהן נקבע לפי מספר המניות מחכות למחיר היחידה של הקרן, שעוד לא נאסף". This line explained the "עוד לא נאסף".

## 3. Block by block, top to bottom

1. **Title, "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן"**: Read it. Clear.
2. **Index buttons (S&P 500 selected)**: Used them. I was glad to see "האתר לא ממליץ על מדד" (the site doesn't recommend an index).
3. **Explanation of the S&P 500**: Read it. "אפשר להחזיק אותו גם דרך קרן חוץ" (you can also hold it through a foreign fund) made me hopeful my fund would be covered.
4. **Sliders**: Used them, only to check my numbers. The line about "שער הדולר 3.16 ₪" I skimmed.
5. **The three summary boxes**: Used them. The clearest part of the page.
6. **"כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים"** (the coloured cost bars): Used them, but they confused me (see 4 and 5).
7. **"העלות אצלכם, לעומת הזוג הבא"**: Skimmed. "1 ₪ יותר" and "58 ₪ פחות" are tiny amounts, so I stopped worrying about choosing between the top two.
8. **Fund list (left)**: Used it to find my fund. Scrolling past about 20 Israeli funds with all their coloured tags was tiring.
9. **Account list (right, "כל החשבונות")**: Skimmed. I noticed my bank isn't on top. The "לא בחישוב" lines (discounts not included) I mostly skipped.
10. **Interactive Brokers / "אינטראקטיב ישראל" boxes, marked "אין נתון"** (no data): Read them, because a foreign fund is bought through a broker like that. They showed a number for a *different* iShares fund (82,848 ₪), not mine. That was disappointing.
11. **"מה כתוב בפרסום, מול התעריפון"**: Skimmed. Useful as a warning that advertised prices aren't always real, but it doesn't help with my fund.
12. **"מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם"** (the line chart and table): Skimmed. I took away one point: more years matters most, "19,116 ₪ יותר".
13. **"עם נטרול מט״ח או בלי"** (with or without currency hedging): Mostly skipped. Too many percentages and bar charts, and my fund isn't part of it. I read only the bottom line, "הנטרול לא מגן מירידה של השוק" (hedging doesn't protect against a market drop).
14. **"מתחילים מבחירה אחת"** (the waterfall chart): Confused me. It starts from Jerusalem and an MTF fund at 79,176 ₪, which I never chose.
15. **"עכשיו: ... ירושלים"** (the two tables): Used them, because this is the only place my fund has a number.
16. **Footer notes**: Read every line. One of them explained my "עוד לא נאסף".

## 4. Lists, tables and charts: what I looked at and what I ignored

- **Cost bars**: I looked at the totals on the left (6,876 / 6,919) and the big pink section (5,703). From the legend I think the big pink is tax ("מס"), so most of my cost is tax, not fees. I couldn't be fully sure, because there are two pinks in the legend that look almost the same, "המרת מטבע" (currency conversion) and "מס" (tax). I ignored the thin green sliver.
- **Fund list**: I looked at the fund name, the right-hand column ("לעומת הבחירה", compared to your choice, in shekels) and the red tags. I ignored the middle column of percentages ("+0.37% בשנה אחת"), because I didn't know what it compares against. I ignored most coloured tags ("צוברת", "עסקה חליפית", "כמה דרכים יחד") except the red ones, "מס רק במכירה" and "מס על כל חלוקה". On my fund the red tag **"מס רק במכירה"** (tax only when selling) has a lock on it, and red made me nervous.
- **Account list**: I looked at the big number (86,492, 83,396 …) and the name. I ignored the small underlined number (1,057 ₪) and the orange/yellow bars.
- **Line chart in "מה הכי משנה"**: I only looked at the colour key on the right and the yellow "שנים" line. I ignored the axes.
- **Hedging bar charts**: Ignored.
- **"עכשיו" tables**: I looked at "נשאר בסוף" (left at the end) and "יותר/פחות" (more/less), plus the red bar next to my fund. I ignored the thin green bars.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- **Why my fund says "אין מחיר כאן" in one place but shows "59,196 ₪ … פחות 19,980 ₪" in another.** Which one should I believe?
- **The lock symbol.** The key says "נשען על כלל מס פתוח: מוצג ולא מדורג" (rests on an open tax rule: shown but not ranked). What is an "open tax rule"? Would I really lose 20,000 shekels in tax, or is it a guess?
- **The code under my fund's name, "IE00B5BMR087".** It is exactly the same code as the line right below it, "iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Accumulating)". Did the page mix my fund up with a different one? That worries me.
- **"Swap".** The page never explains what it means, and that is the main way my fund differs from the others. In the Israeli funds' tags I see "עסקה חליפית" (swap deal), but nobody tells me if it's good or bad for my money.
- **"4D" and "4A".** I gathered 4A is hedged and 4D isn't, but only after a lot of reading.
- **Why the "מתחילים מבחירה אחת" chart starts with Jerusalem and an MTF fund.**
- **"העמלות זו על זו"** (fees on top of fees) in the legend.

## 6. What I wanted to know and couldn't find

- **One simple line for my own fund:** if I buy it through a foreign broker, roughly how much would I have after 10 years, next to the 86,492.
- **Which Israeli account even lets me buy a foreign fund, and what it charges.** Pesagot "אין שורה לניירות ערך זרים" (has no line for foreign securities). Interactive is "אין נתון" (no data).
- **What "מס רק במכירה" means in shekels for me**, compared with the Israeli funds.
- **Whether a fund bought abroad is riskier for someone my age.** For example, what happens to it if I die (the American funds get "מס עיזבון אמריקאי", US estate tax; mine doesn't. Is that good?), and how hard it is to sell.
- **Is 0.05% a lot or a little?** It isn't said anywhere in plain words.

## 7. If half the page had to go, what goes first

1. The whole **"עם נטרול מט״ח או בלי"** section, with its two bar charts and the table of years.
2. The **"מה הכי משנה"** line chart (keep only the one sentence about years).
3. The **"מה כתוב בפרסום, מול התעריפון"** box.
4. Most of the **coloured tags** in the fund list.
5. The **"מתחילים מבחירה אחת"** waterfall chart.

I'd keep the inputs, the three summary boxes, the fund and account lists, the "עכשיו" table and the footer notes. I'd also want my own fund either explained properly or clearly marked "we can't price this yet".
